subject: Re: Encord follow up
text:
Hey Nick,

Great talking with you yesterday.

Attached is a zip file containing:

   - 11 sample images
   - Labels
   - Simplified Ontology

This is a contrived example, feel free to reformat things to keep it simple.

What we would love to see and understand:

   - The interaction with s3, object retrieval, how annotations are
   persisted
   - The establishment and enforcement of ontologies/codebooks
   - Annotating with categorical labels, and bounding boxes
   - How we could accomplish separate queues for annotation
   - Capabilities for data exploration (graphing, clustering, filtering)
   - How we could accomplish case management (notifications, mentions,
   triage into other queues, alarms, tagging, etc.)
      - Ex) monitoring the photos of stool submissions for a particular dog
      over time
      - We're pretty flexible on how we might accomplish this

Let me know if you have any follow up questions for us!

Brad
